 IGN Misc • Nov. 3, 2026 
 Bethesda Game Studios: Official 40th Anniversary Video (feat. Todd Howard)
 Longtime Bethesda Game Studios director Todd Howard celebrates the developer's 40th anniversary by looking back at the games it's built over its four decades, from the big ones you definitely remember (The Elder Scrolls, Fallout, Starfield) to the smaller ones you might not (Gridiron, The Terminator). Stay tuned to the final minute of the video, where Howard reveals the full name and logo for The Elder Scrolls 6, being The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel.
